\newcommand{\vAppendixGeneral}{\paragraph{Other corpora.} Haiku and Sonnet answer the Civil Comments prompt verbatim on every comment of CAD, Qian et al.'s Reddit and Gab, CGA-Wiki and BAD. Shown the parent, a reply takes its label with the parent and roots keep their label without it (as do replies whose parent has no text); the depth law among replies uses depth $\ge 1$. The rewrite labels every gold-negative comment of the four forums that the detector matches, original and edited, shuffled together, and the rewrite with the parent shown labels every Civil Comments reply of the 5\% sample whose text or parent the detector matches: as written, with the reply rewritten, and with both rewritten.}
